recognition_cue: A three-leaf Centella source silhouette with one central vein system and a small extract droplet.
visual_meaning: A botanical source cue that keeps the consumer term Cica separate from the exact ingredient declaration and extract version.

motion_contract.entrance: Draw the stems first, unfold the leaves from their bases, then land the extract droplet.
motion_contract.ambient: Use one slow botanical breath across the leaf group and a restrained droplet highlight shift.
motion_contract.resolve: The version ring completes only when an exact declaration or extract version is supplied.
host_rules: Keep the leaves as one botanical family rather than many decorative sprigs.
Use the incomplete version ring when product specification is absent.
Do not animate the veins as biological transport or penetration without scoped evidence.
Keep all motion finite and owned by the host timeline.

chapter_open.purpose: Reintroduce the botanical subject at a chapter boundary.

continuity_anchor.purpose: Keep Centella present while a label, source or formula becomes primary.

diagram_node.purpose: Act as the source node in declaration and extract-version diagrams.

evidence_companion.purpose: Maintain subject continuity without competing with study details.

recap_token.purpose: Return the ingredient as a simplified memory marker.

unknown_version.purpose: Signal that Cica has not yet been resolved to an exact declaration or extract.

reentry.first_appearance: Use the full stem, leaf and droplet reveal once.
reentry.later_appearances: Return with a short scale or match-position resolve; do not replay the botanical unfold.
reentry.chapter_return: Preserve leaf orientation and accent color so the actor reads before its label.

recognition_tests.small_size_mode: Keep the three-leaf silhouette and droplet; suppress fine veins before reducing further.

disclosure: Illustrative botanical actor. The exact declaration, plant part, extraction process and standardization require product-specific information.
